698.title: Upload a tour video from the phone, straight onto the venue page
humanItems: On a phone (or the PC), on a venue page, tap «העלה סרטון סיור», pick or record a short video: a progress bar runs, then the video is first in «סרטוני סיור» with today's date and the chip «הועלה»; «פתח סרטון» plays it in a new tab; after a reload it is still there.
A video over 100 MB is refused before any upload with «הסרטון גדול מדי (עד 100MB)», and the venue is unchanged.
